result.subject: Welcome to Our London Office – Wednesday 11 November
result.body:
Dear EU neobank team,

We look forward to welcoming you on Wednesday 11 November at 10:00 for a due diligence visit.

Our office is located at 3rd Floor, 21 Copper Row, London EC2A 4LT.

Please proceed to the ground‑floor reception and present photo ID to collect building passes. The nearest stations are Liverpool Street (6 min walk) and Moorgate (8 min). Guest Wi‑Fi details will be displayed on the welcome screen in your meeting room.

You will be greeted by our CPO in Meeting room 3.

Agenda:
- Welcome and introductions
- Company and control‑environment overview
- Document walkthrough and Q&A
- Follow‑up requests and next steps

Kind regards,
Business Operations
